scenes.text: Learn to identify common features of graphs that use many-to-one correspondence and use that understanding to draw bar graphs or pictographs, complete with title, labelled axes, key or legend, to represent data collected (up to 4 categories of data) and use understanding of many-to-one correspondence to solve simple problems (how many altogether, comparing, or take apart problems) requiring interpretation of many-to- one bar graphs (up to 4 categories of data)
A bar chart displays banana equals 36. Which bar height should be used? The answer is 36. The labelled vertical axis must reach the recorded value.
A class recorded 4 votes for mangoes. How high should its bar be on an axis marked in ones? Pause and solve it in your exercise book.
The answer is 4. Bar height equals the recorded total.
